meta.title: Skills & MCP capabilities
meta.description: Manage Skills and MCP servers from the DSH sidebar. On the Host side, skill discovery is taken over so the global ~/.agents/skills directory never enters the model catalog; only skills you explicitly select are synchronized. Search, create (including ZIP skill packages), edit, toggle, batch-delete, and inspect symlink or copy sync modes for user-level and project-level skills. MCP supports editing Manager and standalone entries in form or JSON, toggling, connection tests, reconnect, and imports from other apps. Auto-update and GitHub Release notes are built in. The interface follows the DSH language setting, while Skill and MCP content stays in its original language.
